Our “warranty” for defective items works as an exchange policy, not a refund.

You must report issues within 7 days of purchase/delivery.
We’ll exchange items that are damaged, expired, have a manufacturer’s defect, or the wrong product was delivered.
Items must be unused, in original packaging, with proof of purchase.

Some products with a printed quality guarantee on the packaging may be considered for exchange if:

The issue is reported within 7 days, and
At least 50% of the product remains, and
The food is misshapen or has unusual color.

All items are strictly non‑refundable.
